##### Project general facts

Primero Residences by Main Realty is a residential building that combines contemporary architecture with timeless elegance. Inspired by modern American design, the building features clean lines, smooth curves, and a strong focus on comfort and style. The project offers 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom apartments, including duplex options and units with private pools, all with spacious and practical layouts.

Residents have access to a wide range of amenities, including a swimming pool and a toddler pool, a gym, a yoga area, and steam and sauna rooms. Families can enjoy indoor and outdoor children's play areas, while the clubhouse, outdoor lounge and BBQ area provide space for relaxing and socialising. A stylish lobby with 24/7 concierge service completes the residential experience.

The apartments feature modern finishes with high-quality materials, soft-toned interiors, built-in storage and integrated wardrobes. Italian-inspired kitchens are fitted with handleless Gola drawers and Calacatta Gold countertops, and come equipped with a gas hob, oven, a refrigerator from a French brand, and a built-in washer-dryer, with appliances from brands such as Bosch and LG. The apartments are delivered semi-furnished.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Al Furjan, a residential community in Dubai close to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular destinations. The community covers approximately 560 hectares and includes both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse choice of homes.

Al Furjan is known for its well-planned infrastructure and a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs. This variety creates an attractive and welcoming atmosphere throughout the neighbourhood.

The community offers landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centres, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. Retail centres within Al Furjan provide convenient access to shopping, dining and everyday services, making the area well suited to families and professionals.
